checks: Existing writer was opened before admission; verification failed closed, then succeeded after writer release.
After successful admission, opening another writer was denied until both cache and receipt owners released handles.
For two model assets, clearing cache and dropping the original receipt did not release protections held by two clones; dropping one clone still blocked modification.
Immediately after the final clone was released, same-length corruption of a secondary asset succeeded, and a fresh SHA-based admission rejected it.
After clearing the cache and releasing the only receipt, an immediate same-length primary asset modification was rejected by fresh admission.

limits: The first run is the unmodified fixed-source model_integrity unit test subset, not the entire Windows CI job.
The second run appends test-only functions in a separate local worktree; production logic was not modified or committed.
Synthetic temporary files only; no user model, audio or private contents were accessed.
No GPU component, SDK, installer, real model loading, external mmap/native reopen path, or release acceptance was tested.
Windows-only observations do not establish Linux or macOS behavior.
